papers.title: Fine-Grained Product Class Recognition for Assisted Shopping
papers.abstract: Assistive solutions for a better shopping experience can improve the quality of life of people, in particular also of visually impaired shoppers. We present a system that visually recognizes the fine-grained product classes of items on a shopping list, in shelves images taken with a smartphone in a grocery store. Our system consists of three components: (a) We automatically recognize useful text on product packaging, e.g., product name and brand, and build a mapping of words to product classes based on the large-scale GroceryProducts dataset. When the user populates the shopping list, we automatically infer the product class of each entered word. (b) We perform fine-grained product class recognition when the user is facing a shelf. We discover discriminative patches on product packaging to differentiate between visually similar product classes and to increase the robustness against continuous changes in product design. (c) We continuously improve the recognition accuracy through active learning. Our experiments show the robustness of the proposed method against cross-domain challenges, and the scalability to an increasing number of products with minimal re-training.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanical context; it focuses on computer vision for product recognition.

summary_zh.motivation: 辅助购物体验，特别是视障人士。
summary_zh.method: 利用文本识别和判别性补丁进行细粒度产品分类。
summary_zh.result: 在跨领域挑战中表现鲁棒，且易于扩展。

summary_en.motivation: To improve shopping assistance, especially for visually impaired individuals, by recognizing fine-grained product classes.
summary_en.method: The system uses text recognition on packaging and discriminative patch discovery for fine-grained classification.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates robustness to cross-domain challenges and scalability to new products with minimal retraining.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on the GroceryProducts dataset with active learning to improve accuracy.

papers.title: Difference in periprosthetic acetabular bone mineral density: Prior total hip arthroplasty: Osteonecrosis of the femoral head versus primary osteoarthritis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of Regensburg, Kaiser-Karl-V Allee 3, 93077 Bad Abbach, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Benjamin Craiovan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of Regensburg, Kaiser-Karl-V Allee 3, 93077 Bad Abbach, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注髋臼侧骨密度变化，而非股骨柄应力遮挡或微动，与用户研究方向间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on acetabular bone mineral density after THA, not on femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同病因THA后髋臼骨密度差异
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析股骨头坏死与骨关节炎患者术后髋臼BMD
summary_zh.result: 股骨头坏死组髋臼BMD下降更显著

summary_en.motivation: To compare periprosthetic acetabular bone mineral density changes between patients with osteonecrosis of the femoral head and primary osteoarthritis after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study measuring acetabular BMD using DEXA in two patient groups.
summary_en.result: Patients with osteonecrosis showed greater acetabular BMD loss than those with osteoarthritis.

papers.title: La educación artística como elemento clave en el proceso de aprendizaje en preescolar

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论学前教育中的艺术教育，与有限元代理建模、生物力学或植入物设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about art education in preschool, with no mention of computational modeling, surrogate methods, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical engineering.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨艺术教育在学前学习过程中的关键作用
summary_zh.method: 分析西班牙艺术学校策略及艺术家方法进行比较
summary_zh.result: 主张艺术教育是学前教育的核心资源

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates whether art education is a key element in preschool learning processes.
summary_en.method: It compares strategies used in Spanish art schools and methods from notable artists and lecturers.
summary_en.result: The paper argues that art education is an essential resource for motivation and active learning in preschool.
summary_en.validation: Validation is based on qualitative analysis and comparison of educational strategies.
